d: Vodafone is Oman’s latest Network Operator. The presence of Vodafone in Oman will contribute to the development of all sectors, including the economic and educational sectors, and in line with Oman Vision 2040.

Our purpose is to ‘Connect for a Better Future ‘which underpins everything we do. Our solutions will positively impact society as we connect everyone in Oman for a better future. What we offer are market-leading customer experiences and innovative digital services.

We are looking for energetic self-starters to work in this 100% Omani owned, positive collaborative start-up environment, where key talents will create Oman’s happiest workplace. We are looking for individuals with an entrepreneurial mindset who get excited by challenges and constant change and truly want to positively impact the lives of our customers and the people of Oman.

As part of our Budget and Vendor Management team, we are looking for a Technology Financial Analyst to provide financial planning, analysis, control and reporting across the Technology function. The role will manage Capex and Opex tracking, budgeting, forecasting, purchase orders, invoices, accruals and vendor expenditure, enabling accurate financial decisions, strong governance and effective cost optimisation.
The role will work closely with Network, IT and Operations teams to ensure alignment between financial planning, technology requirements and operational priorities.
q: Strong financial analysis, budgeting, forecasting and management reporting capability.
Sound understanding of Capex, Opex, accruals, commitments, purchase orders and invoice lifecycle management.
High attention to detail, sound judgement and a control-focused mindset.
Ability to translate complex financial data into concise, actionable management insights.
Advanced stakeholder management and ability to work across Technology, Finance, Supply Chain and vendors.
Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities and meet reporting deadlines.
Commercial awareness and a proactive cost-optimisation mindset.
Minimum 1 year of relevant experience in financial analysis, FP&A, management accounting or Technology finance.
Experience in telecommunications, IT, digital services or project-based environments is preferred.
Accuracy and timeliness of monthly Technology financial reporting and accrual submissions.
Forecast accuracy and quality of budget variance explanations.
Percentage of Technology expenditure maintained within approved budgets.
Timely reconciliation of open purchase orders, invoices, accruals and financial commitments.
Reduction in ageing commitments, delayed invoices and unutilised budget.
Value of cost savings, avoidance and optimisation opportunities identified.
Compliance with financial controls, procurement requirements and audit actions.
Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration or a related discipline.
Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including financial modelling, PivotTables, lookups and reconciliations.
Experience with ERP and procurement systems such as SAP, Oracle or equivalent.
Power BI or similar business intelligence experience is preferred.
ACCA, CIMA, CMA, CPA, CFA or a similar professional certification is an advantage.
Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
